symbols.reasoning: Computes current-recipe theoretical usage versus actual Usage+loss within optional inclusive time range. Fetches active recipe ingredient lines, noncancelled sold order lines, resolves variant override then product fallback, groups sold counts and multiplies converted base quantity by sold count. Unconvertible yield line is skipped, and unchecked multiply/add can overflow extreme stored quantities; no completeness marker returned for skipped conversion. Does not net refunds or snapshot sale-time recipe: explicitly stated current-recipe limitation; resulting gap is neutral diagnostic, not theft or direct stock posting. Independent reads can straddle metadata/sales changes. Actual count adjustment remains separate field via domain.
